visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a grey knit sweater over a checkered shirt, is sitting in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a large, unfolded electronic device and smiles brightly, gesturing with her right hand toward the screen while looking directly into the camera lens. (2) The camera cuts to a tight close-up of the back of the black device, showing a fine carbon-fiber texture and three circular camera lenses arranged vertically. The lighting is studio-bright, reflecting off the edges of the metallic camera housing and the sleek finish of the frame. (3) Returning to the woman, she is now holding the device in its folded, single-screen smartphone state. She holds it up to display a digital clock on the front screen (16:27), her eyes wide and expressive as she continues to speak. (4) She demonstrates the unfolding mechanism, opening two hinges to transform the device from a standard phone size into a large 10-inch horizontal tablet screen. Her fingers are positioned at the edges of the display, carefully guiding the expansion of the flexible screen panels. (5) A screen capture sequence demonstrates the camera's zoom capabilities by showing a close-up of a printed newspaper or book. The text becomes remarkably sharp and legible as the software enhances the image on the device's display. (6) Detailed text overlays and UI menus appear on the screen, listing technical specifications such as 16GB RAM and 512GB storage. The woman is shown interacting with the screen, her fingers tapping and scrolling through the interface fluidly. (7) A multi-tasking demonstration shows the screen divided into four distinct windows, running different applications simultaneously like a desktop interface. The background setting remains consistent, showing warm indoor lighting and framed artwork on the wall behind the subject. (8) The final visual phase shows a vibrant animation of a blue, glowing-eyed cat creature filling the screen of the device. The woman folds the device back into its phone form with a satisfied expression, ending the presentation with a friendly wave.
